description: Mike's Legislative Philosophy 1.Honor and protect the US Bill of Rights. 2.Every bill passed by the State Legislature must be constitutional. 3.Protect private property rights. 4.Protect the Taxpayer's Bill of Rights (TABOR). 5.The State Legislature works for the people — not the other way around. 6.Ask first: Is a new bill truly necessary to achieve the desired outcome?…
